data: TerraSAR-X descending point set over Kop van Zuid, provided for the course by R.F. Hanssen; aggregates only
unit: rates mm/yr, quadratic mm/yr^2, seasonal mm, tilt mm per 100 m per yr, bx mm per m of easting; series: mean displacement of the building's points, mm, line of sight; every _sd is the spread of the points themselves about that mean, and scatter_mm the typical spread within one pass
frame: centroid_local in metres east and north of RD (93000, 435600); from the BAG outline, not from the points
labels_note: names come from BUILDING_NAMES: the footprint centroid is matched to a named building in Wikidata and the match is only kept where the construction year and the 3DBAG roof height agree as well; two buildings stay unnamed
bag3d_note: 3DBAG attributes for every building in the mesh; heights in m NAP; CC BY 4.0
